closing.summary: Big strengths are magnesium, protein, and vitamin E, but the biggest weaknesses are vitamins, low fat quality, and low protein quality. It's good for blood and oxygen support, bone health, and immune support because iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, calcium and magnesium can support bones, and vitamin C and zinc help support the immune system.
